title: History of Woman Suffrage, Volume II
summary: "History of Woman Suffrage, Volume II" by Stanton, Anthony, and Gage is a historical work published in 1882. This volume chronicles the American women's suffrage movement from 1861 to 1876, documenting a pivotal fifteen-year period through letters, speeches, newspaper clippings, and court records. Written from the perspective of the National Woman Suffrage Association's leaders, it captures the movement's struggles and strategies during and after the Civil War, preserving primary sources that reveal how women fought for their right to vote across a transforming nation.
